_doc: Design benchmark v0. An agent gets the intent, the visible scenes and a budget through the tool surface. Its final design is scored on BLIND scenes (bench/blind-scenes.json) that no tool reveals. Score = relative improvement of the blind metric over the starting design, zero if the design is invalid, leaves the allowed envelope, or the simulator skeptic distrusts any blind run.

tasks.intent: Make the walker cover more ground per crank revolution. You may simulate on flat ground; the final design is judged on terrain you have not seen.
Make the walker use less input energy per metre walked. You may simulate on flat ground; the final design is judged on terrain you have not seen.
